script.title: शादी से लौटते राम को परशुराम ने ललकारा, शर्त थी एक धनुष 🚩
sentences: शादी से लौटते राम का रास्ता परशुराम ने रोक लिया।
रामायण के अनुसार, सीता से विवाह के बाद राम मिथिला से अयोध्या लौट रहे थे।
रास्ते में धरती काँपी, धूल का तूफ़ान उठा, और सामने परशुराम खड़े थे।
उन्होंने राम को युद्ध के लिए ललकारा, एक शर्त पर।
मेरे धनुष शारंग पर बाण चढ़ाकर छोड़ो।
दशरथ ने बेटे के लिए विनती की, पर परशुराम नहीं माने।
राम ने उनके हाथ से धनुष लिया और चढ़ा दिया।
उसी पल परशुराम की दिव्य शक्ति चली गई, वे समझ गए कि राम विष्णु के अवतार हैं।
विष्णु के छठे अवतार माने जाने वाले परशुराम राम की परिक्रमा कर महेंद्र पर्वत लौट गए।
script.description:
रामायण की चर्चा के बीच, विवाह के ठीक बाद का यह प्रसंग।
जब परशुराम ने राम की परीक्षा ली।
visuals: Rama breaking bow Sita swayamvara painting
claims_en: Parashurama confronted Rama on Rama's homeward journey after his wedding
In the Ramayana, after Rama's wedding to Sita at Mithila, his party was returning to Ayodhya
The party saw inauspicious signs; amid an earthquake and a dust storm Parashurama appeared
Parashurama challenged Rama to combat, on a condition
The condition was that Rama string/place an arrow in Parashurama's bow Sharanga and discharge it
Dasharatha pleaded with Parashurama to spare Rama this task; Parashurama ignored it
Rama seized the bow from Parashurama and strung it
This made Parashurama bereft of his divine power, and he acknowledged Rama as an incarnation of Vishnu
Parashurama is the sixth avatar of Vishnu
Parashurama circumambulated Rama in worship and returned to the mountain Mahendra
scenes: Extreme close-up of the sage-warrior Parashurama's face, matted locks, fierce burning eyes, an axe on his shoulder, dust swirling, stormy amber light, traditional Indian iconography
A royal wedding party with chariots and elephants travelling from Mithila toward Ayodhya, young prince Rama and Sita in a decorated chariot, golden afternoon light, wide shot
The ground shaking and a dust storm rising on the road as the wedding party halts in alarm, Parashurama emerging through the dust, dramatic backlight
Parashurama pointing at calm young prince Rama, challenging him, courtiers frozen behind, tense medium shot
Parashurama holding out a huge ornate divine bow, Sharanga, toward Rama, close framing on the bow and their faces
Old King Dasharatha with folded hands pleading before Parashurama, worry on his face, Rama standing quietly behind, soft dusty light
Prince Rama effortlessly bending and stringing the great bow, serene expression, a glow around him, low angle heroic framing
Parashurama's fierce face softening into awe and recognition as a gentle light leaves him, close-up
Parashurama walking reverently around Rama with folded hands, then distant mountains of Mahendra at dawn behind him, calm wide shot
